args.message: Each region's share of revenue from orders with status 'ok'. Total 'ok' revenue is 294,707.55. North has the largest share at about 33.2%, then South at about 31.6%, East at about 20.2% and West at about 14.6%. Orders whose customer has no known region are the null group, at about 0.4%. The region revenues add up to the full 'ok' total.
